project: RAI Solar A — Boulder City (live run)

dimensions.name: land
flags: Parcel-level Energy Resource designation only assumed — doc's own red flag says it must not be inferred from regional proximity; doc's 78 rejected as unconditioned
No executed land control: only a planned Q3 2026 term sheet; site control is a FERC Order 2023 cluster-entry gate
Gen-tie corridor unverified; possible BLM crossing would trigger ROW grant + NEPA + Western Solar Plan conformance (Townsite Solar 2 precedent: 2-3 yrs, now under IBLA appeal)
Positives: 6.0 ac/MW plausible, >1 GW operating Eldorado Valley solar complex, structurally pro-solar city (leases ~35% of city revenue)

dimensions.name: law
flags: KILL CRITERION: OBBBA physical-work BOC deadline (Jul 4, 2026) passed as of doc's own Aug 14, 2026 source date; construction starts 2028-2029 and no BOC/continuity evidence exists — 30% solar ITC (~$60M) forfeited; only storage ITC survives
Zoning citation error: doc cites BCMC 'Chapter 19' but governing ordinance is BCMC Title 11 — 'permitted use' conclusion must be re-verified against the correct title at parcel level
Tortoise 100%-coverage protocol surveys starting Q4 2026 likely miss the Sep-Oct 2026 window → +6 months to layout freeze, cascading into design/construction
Clark County MSHCP §10 disturbance fee (~$550/ac ≈ $0.6M on 1,080 ac) not itemized; UEPA/PUCN siting-cert applicability unresolved

dimensions.name: finance
flags: CAPEX $1.12/Wac is 21-28% below PV-only benchmarks ($1.43 LBNL / $1.56 NREL ATB); BESS scope never stated — at $200-350/kWh the 320 MWh battery adds $64-112M, a realistic $40-70M+ shortfall vs combined $240-280M
~$60M solar ITC loss is a ~30% cost swing — triple the +10% stress the doc claims to survive; stress test calibrated to a below-market base
Guardrails miscalibrated: $24M interconnection re-run trigger (11.9%) exceeds the demonstrated +10% ($20.2M) viability bound — upgrades of $20.2-24M break economics without firing the trigger
8% escalation reserve below prudent 10-15% and set equal to the 8% re-run trigger — zero buffer; no debt sizing, DSCR, contingency, offtake price, or P50/P90 disclosed

dimensions.name: materials
flags: GSU/large transformer lead times 128-144 wks already exceed the doc's 24-month trigger; Q4 2029 COD with 6-month float requires PO ~Sep 2026-Jan 2027 — the 2028-2029 procurement window is 1.5-2+ years too late
'Reserve before 30% design' (2027-2028) is borderline-to-late; no transformer PO executed per KB red-flag checklist
BESS supply (FEOC-compliant cells, 26-52 wk integrator slots) unaddressed despite storage being effectively mandatory in NV
Construction water budget (300-600 AF over ~2 yrs, $0.5-2M) not quantified; module AD/CVD and Section 232 escalation exposure unhedged

dimensions.name: demand
flags: 'Optional' BESS contradicts NV market reality: summer evening peak makes 4-hr storage effectively mandatory (Gemini 690 MW + 1,400 MWh norm; Oct 2024 PUCN approval of 1,019 MW + 590 MW storage) — if BESS is truly out of scope, revenue and the doc's demand score (81) are overstated
No offtake price target vs ~$45-65/MWh blended NV new-build benchmark; no P50/P90 (regional expectation ~490-540 GWh/yr, 27.9-32.3% CF measured at Copper Mountain)

Positives: RPS 50% by 2030, strongest POI geography in S. Nevada (Eldorado/Marketplace-Mead hub), Greenlink West 525 kV energizing 2027, multiple offtake paths (NV Energy IRP, NRS 704B exits, data-center bilateral), PPA prices rising ~9%/yr

claims: Economics remain viable under +10% CAPEX stress
sources: KB benchmarks: LBNL 2023 $1.43/Wac; NREL ATB $1.56/Wac; BESS $200-350/kWh turnkey
contradictions.explanation: $1.12/Wac is 21-28% below PV-only benchmarks ($257-281M for 180 MWac). The doc never states whether the BESS is inside the $202M; at $200-350/kWh the battery adds $64-112M, so a realistic combined cost is $240-280M+ (KB), a $40-70M+ shortfall. The +10% stress case ($222M) is still below the low PV-only benchmark and excludes BESS entirely - the stress test is calibrated to a below-market base.

sources: KB: OBBBA - solar ITC/PTC requires physical-work BOC by Jul 4, 2026 (no 5% safe harbor for >1.5 MW solar); continuity safe harbor needs PIS by Dec 31, 2030; storage ITC survives
contradictions.explanation: As of the doc's own source-access date (Aug 14, 2026) the Jul 4, 2026 BOC deadline has passed and construction starts 2028-2029, so the 30% solar ITC (~$60M on $202M) is forfeited absent BOC evidence - a ~30% cost swing, triple the +10% stress the doc claims to survive. The finance facts contain no tax-credit, BOC, or continuity analysis at all.

claims: Reserve transformer before 30% design if delivery exceeds 24 months
sources: KB: 2025-26 GSU/large transformer lead times 128-144 weeks (2.5-2.8 yrs); >=6 months delivery-to-COD float required
contradictions.explanation: Real lead times (128-144 wk) already exceed the doc's 24-month trigger. Backward from Q4 2029 COD with 6-month float, the PO must be placed ~Sep 2026-Jan 2027; even delivery-at-COD requires ordering by ~Mar-Jul 2027. The 2028-2029 procurement window is 1.5-2+ years too late, and 'before 30% design' (2027-2028) is borderline-to-late.

claims: Re-run model if interconnection upgrade estimate exceeds $24M
contradictions.explanation: $24M is 11.9% of $202M, but viability is only demonstrated to +10% ($20.2M). Upgrades of $20.2-24M break the modeled economics without firing the re-run trigger - the two financial guardrails are miscalibrated, and network-upgrade cost shock is the #1 interconnection dropout driver (KB).

claims: Feasible gen-tie corridor assumed at screening
sources: KB: NV Energy BAA (NEVP OASIS) FERC Order 2023 cluster - site control gates entry; IR-to-COD ~5 yrs; cluster study must complete ~mid-2027 for a Q4 2029 COD
contradictions.explanation: Application-to-COD is ~36 months vs a ~60-month norm, requiring cluster-study completion ~mid-2027, essentially immediately after application. Only a planned term sheet (not site control) is evidenced, and no queue position or executed study exists.

claims: Tortoise/sensitive-species surveys required before layout freeze
sources: KB: tortoise 100%-coverage protocol surveys gate layout freeze; miss the Sep-Oct 2026 window = +6 months; MSHCP fee ~$550/ac (~$0.6M on 1,080 ac)
contradictions.explanation: Surveys starting Q4 2026 at best catch the tail of the Sep-Oct 2026 protocol window; missing it adds ~6 months to layout freeze, cascading into 2027-2028 design and 2028-2029 construction. The ~$0.6M MSHCP disturbance fee is not itemized in the $202M.

claims: Battery storage is optional (80 MW / 320 MWh)
sources: KB: NV summer evening peak makes 4-hr BESS effectively mandatory economically (Gemini 690 MW + 1,400 MWh norm; Oct 2024 PUCN approval of 1,019 MW + 590 MW storage)
contradictions.explanation: Calling the BESS 'optional' lets the screening show a PV-only-scale CAPEX, but in the NV Energy market 4-hour storage is effectively required for the project to be economic. If BESS is in scope, CAPEX is understated by $64-112M; if truly out of scope, the revenue and DEMAND score (81) are overstated. The document cannot have both.

claims: Feasible gen-tie corridor assumed at screening
Construction 2028-2029 subject to permits and interconnection
sources: KB: gen-tie crossing BLM triggers ROW grant + NEPA + Western Solar Plan conformance; Townsite Solar 2 BLM NEPA ~2-3 yrs, now under IBLA appeal
contradictions.explanation: The corridor is an unverified assumption and the doc is silent on a BLM crossing. If the gen-tie crosses BLM land, a 2-3 year NEPA/ROW process (plus appeal risk) from a Q4 2026-Q2 2027 application collides with the 2028 construction start and Q4 2029 COD; no schedule contingency exists.

claims: Boulder City Municipal Code, Chapter 19 - Energy Resource Zone permits solar generation and transmission facilities
sources: KB: Energy Resource zoning verified verbatim on city site, but governing ordinance is BCMC Title 11 (GO-to-ER rezonings via Planning Commission then Council, active 2023-2025)
contradictions.explanation: The 17,107-acre figure is verified real, but the doc cites 'Chapter 19' while research identifies the governing code as BCMC Title 11. The citation error underpins the LAW factor (72) and the 'permitted use' conclusion; it must be corrected and parcel-level designation confirmed against the correct title.

claims: Red flag: Energy Resource designation must not be inferred from regional proximity alone
Parcel assumed to fall within Energy Resource zoning
contradictions.explanation: The 78 score rests on an assumed, unverified zoning designation that the doc's own red flag says must not be inferred from proximity. Scoring land risk LOW-MODERATE while the core siting assumption is unconfirmed is internally inconsistent; the score should be conditioned on parcel-level zoning and legal-access verification.

claims: Re-run model if EPC index rises more than 8%
sources: KB: 8% escalation reserve is thin; 10-15% prudent
contradictions.explanation: The 8% reserve is below the prudent 10-15% range and is set exactly equal to the 8% re-run trigger, so the reserve is fully consumed at precisely the point the model is declared unreliable - zero buffer between reserve exhaustion and unverified economics.
